cases.narrative: In 2/1980, motorists discovered the body of an unidentified female, known for years as Riverside County Jane Doe, at the bottom of a ravine off Highway 74, south of Cahuilla, in an unincorporated area of Riverside County, CA. She was identified in 2026 by Othram Inc. Her cause of death could not be determined, but the case is being investigated as a homicide. She had gone missing from her home in Alabama.
